name: MakerWorks-v2
description: MakerWorks is a 3D printing commerce platform with storefront, instant quoting, checkout, customer order tracking, admin operations, backups, and optional StockWorks and PrintLab integrations.

paths.name: Storage Path
paths.description: Persistent uploads, generated files, and default backup storage.

paths.name: Bulk Import Path
paths.description: Optional source directory for bulk model imports.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port for the MakerWorks web UI.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: PostgreSQL connection string for MakerWorks.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Long random secret used to sign application tokens.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: External URL users use to reach MakerWorks.

variables.name: Storage Directory
variables.description: Internal durable storage root.

variables.name: Backup Directory
variables.description: Internal backup destination. Leave /app/backups when the backup path is mapped.

variables.name: Skip Docker for Backups
variables.description: Use local pg_dump/psql inside the container instead of Docker Compose exec.

variables.name: pg_dump Path
variables.description: pg_dump path inside the MakerWorks image.

variables.name: psql Path
variables.description: psql path inside the MakerWorks image.

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Initial admin email.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Initial admin password. Must be strong in production.

variables.name: Admin Name
variables.description: Initial admin display name.

variables.name: Cookie Secure
variables.description: Set true when MakerWorks is served only over HTTPS.

variables.name: Redis URL
variables.description: Optional Redis URL for background queues. Leave blank to disable queue-backed processing.

variables.name: Currency
variables.description: Server-side pricing currency, USD or CAD.

variables.name: Public Currency
variables.description: Client-side display currency, USD or CAD.

variables.name: StockWorks Base URL
variables.description: Optional StockWorks integration URL on makerworks-net.

variables.name: StockWorks Username
variables.description: Optional StockWorks username.

variables.name: StockWorks Password
variables.description: Optional StockWorks password.

variables.name: PrintLab Base URL
variables.description: Optional PrintLab integration URL on makerworks-net.

variables.name: PrintLab API Key
variables.description: Optional API key sent to PrintLab.

variables.name: PrintLab API Key Header
variables.description: Header used for PrintLab API key auth.

variables.name: PrintLab Webhook Secret
variables.description: Shared secret for PrintLab callbacks into MakerWorks.

variables.name: Stripe Secret Key
variables.description: Optional Stripe secret key.

variables.name: Stripe Publishable Key
variables.description: Optional Stripe publishable key.

variables.name: Stripe Webhook Secret
variables.description: Optional Stripe webhook signing secret.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone.
